followUp.concept: Request an upstream CommandPalette component or production recipe if this recurs across products. The supplied catalog has no matching semantic export. Upstream should own grouped result anatomy, search/result focus navigation, accessible labeling, empty state, and modal integration; applications should continue owning command registration, matching/ranking, permissions, dispatch, and recent-history persistence. This local composition intentionally uses ordinary input/button semantics rather than pretending Select or MenuItem implements a command palette.
